candidate.derivedAnswer: B. There is at least one zero in \((1,3)\).
candidate.answerReason: Continuity and \(f(1)=-3<0<5=f(3)\) guarantee a zero between 1 and 3. Neither endpoint is a zero.

methods.explanation: The function values at the two endpoints have opposite signs, so the continuous graph crosses the \(x\)-axis at least once.
